target_customer: Shoppers in smaller Indian cities and towns who buy groceries and goods together in groups
problem: Price-sensitive shoppers outside the big cities had limited access to deals; group buying lets them unlock discounts together.
business_model: Social e-commerce group buying with margin on goods sold

founders.name: Roshan Farhan
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: 10+ years founding tech startups, management consulting background.

founders.name: Kulapradip Bharali
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: 8+ years in full-stack development and IT consulting.

competitors.name: Meesho
competitors.what: Social commerce reselling platform in India
competitors.traction_then: Named as a leading Indian social commerce startup
competitors.funding_then: Raised $570M in Sept 2021 per later coverage

competitors.name: Bulbul
competitors.traction_then: Named in the 2020 YourStory roundup of social commerce startups

competitors.name: DealShare
competitors.what: Community group buying for groceries in India
competitors.traction_then: Described as the pioneer of the community group buying model; coverage is dated December 2021

technical_complexity.rationale: Consumer app with group ordering and logistics partners; mostly standard engineering, with the operational difficulty lying in fulfillment rather than software.

defensibility.rationale: Group buying mechanics were copyable and well funded rivals already operated in the same cities; no proprietary supply or data moat is described.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Flipkart launched Shopsy and Meesho expanded to groceries per sector coverage; whether this hurt Gobillion is not documented.

market_need_then: Indian group buying and social commerce for tier 2 and 3 towns was an active category in 2020 to 2021, with Meesho raising large rounds and DealShare popularizing community group buying.

identity.voice_and_tone: Positioned as the Pinduoduo for India with a shopping rooms feature (YourStory 2022)

branding.community_and_virality: YourStory and several Indian outlets covered the seed round; no evidence of merch or fan community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Only trade press coverage was found; the name evokes scale and the Pinduoduo comparison was clear, but no organic brand pull is documented.

outcome_analysis: Gobillion raised a reported $2.9M seed in December 2021 and later launched a shopping rooms product in 2022, but YC lists it inactive and no article or post-mortem explaining the end was found, so the cause is not public. Sector coverage shows rival Indian group buying startups such as DealShare and Otipy shrank or shut as funding dried up, which is context only and not evidence about Gobillion.
notes: Directory has no website, so no site fetch was possible. The seed of $2.9M is stated by several outlets (YourStory, Business Standard, Entrepreneur India); the amount for the pre-seed is not stated. CB Insights shows $3.03M over 3 rounds and Inc42 shows two rounds, so round labels and the full investor split conflict across sources. The DealShare entry comes from a December 2021 article, about five months after the Summer 2021 batch. Exit type is unknown because no shutdown notice was found.
